critique.evidence: The screen strongly reframes evaluation around fraud-defense operations: constrained-FPR recall, calibration, alert load, latency, confusion counts, fraud value caught, good value blocked, and measured ablations. This supports the Mastercard risk-and-payment story, especially the 93.8% fraud value caught and 0.00% good value blocked. However, it does not directly connect these results to intent-integrity attacks, Mastercard-specific requirements, transaction value/volume, or a traceable attack-to-defense outcome. The results are presented as authoritative without visible dataset size, test conditions, confidence bounds, threshold rationale, or artifact provenance.
critique.fix: Add a compact, traceable evaluation summary tying each metric to an intent-integrity threat and Mastercard payment outcome, including dataset composition, transaction value/volume, operating-threshold rationale, uncertainty, and links from headline results to representative defended cases.
